calibration.selectionRule: Rank IDs 1..200 excluding all previously observed records by SHA256(seed + colon + decimal ID); take first 40, then sort numerically. No signal, diagnosis, quality or outcome selection.
calibration.role: Prospectively selected calibration cohort. It becomes observed engineering data after the first baseline run and must not later be described as an untouched holdout.

holdout.selectionRule: Rank IDs 1..200 excluding previously observed records and the calibration cohort by SHA256(seed + colon + decimal ID); take first 40, then sort numerically.
holdout.role: Reserved untouched holdout. This PR MUST NOT download or evaluate these records. Enable only after a delineator-v2 candidate and its acceptance rules are frozen.

reference.eventAggregation: Lead II anchors each P, QRS or T event; nearest unused same-wave event in I/V1/V5 within 150 ms completes a four-lead group. Incomplete groups are reported, never imputed.
reference.onsetAggregation: Earliest onset across all four matched leads, only when all four source onsets exist.
reference.peakAggregation: Median peak across all four matched leads.
reference.offsetAggregation: Latest offset across all four matched leads, only when all four source offsets exist.
reference.intervalAssociation: Descriptive engineering association only: for each aggregate QRS, use the latest P peak 20-450 ms before QRS and the earliest T peak 40-800 ms after QRS, with T required before the next QRS minus 20 ms. No diagnosis or rhythm label is used.

productInput: Only {fs, leads}; no ECGCase, generator events, truth, diagnosis, SNR label or source annotations.
limitations: Four-lead aggregate is an evaluation construct, not an original LUDB global annotation.
PR/QT reference association is descriptive and can be physiologically ambiguous in AV dissociation or overlapping waves.
The calibration cohort is not a representative patient sample and becomes development data after first inspection.
Endpoint agreement does not establish diagnostic accuracy, safety or clinical equivalence.
